pay_detail: $250 a week in 2026. Optional lunch hour supervision and late pickup were $10 a day each.
duration: 1 week, 3 hours a day (morning or afternoon sessions)
name: Illinois MakerLab Summer Camps
org: Illinois MakerLab, Gies College of Business, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign
what_you_do: One week, 3 hours a day camps on 3D modeling, 3D printing, Minecraft, generative AI and robot arms in the MakerLab at the Business Instructional Facility.
who_can_apply: Each camp lists its own ages. In 2026 camps were for ages 10 and up (some 10 to 17, some 12 and up). Check the age before registering.
deadline_text: Summer 2026 camps ran June 1 to July 31 and are over. Summer 2027 details will be announced in early 2027.
how_to_apply: Registration opens when 2027 details are posted on the MakerLab summer page. A $20 non-refundable deposit applies.
notes: 2026 camps ran June 1 to July 31. Lunch supervision and late pickup were $10 a day each.
